profile.description: Low-TTFA profile for one AMX worker on an 8-core Intel host with SMT disabled; measured for one and two concurrent requests.

hardware.notes: The host exposes 16 hardware threads and 8 physical cores. Disable SMT before launch; the qualified process uses online CPUs 0-7, one thread per physical core. Do not apply this profile with SMT enabled without requalification.

requirements.isa: AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, AMX tile, AMX INT8 and AMX BF16

server.worker_affinity: one worker pinned to online CPUs 0-7 after SMT is disabled

precision.activations: fp32 at the API boundary; int8 packing is internal to matmat
precision.gemm_backend: AMX INT8/BF16 GEMM where the shape gate is met; AVX-512 VNNI and AVX-512 BF16 fallbacks otherwise

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: Must be absent so the engine sizes OpenBLAS from its phase thread budget.
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.revert: set it explicitly only for a measured override

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: Prevents idle OpenBLAS workers from spinning against the engine pool.

QWEN_AMX_MIN_B.why: Keeps AMX INT8 matmat available from the first batched regime.

QWEN_PREFIX_CACHE.why: Enables reuse of request-independent prefix work.

QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE.why: Must remain absent so the shape-aware AVX-512 VNNI fallback remains available.
QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE.revert: set QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE=1 only for a control run

qualification.workload: Three synchronized waves on the mixed 21-text qualification bank; client concurrency 1 and 2 were measured with SMT disabled.
qualification.notes: In the latest SMT-off confirmation, C=1 measured 112 ms p50 / 322 ms p95 with RTF 0.64; C=2 measured 228 ms p50 / 403 ms p95 with RTF 0.84. This is the latency-first profile; use the multi-client profile for a balanced worker split.
